ValidationRule.description: Defence in depth behind field-level security. References and detail may be cleared for a data deletion request; nothing else may change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(AIViolationRule__c), ISCHANGED(ViolationType__c), ISCHANGED(Severity__c), ISCHANGED(RequestBlocked__c), AND(ISCHANGED(AIConversation__c), NOT(ISBLANK(AIConversation__c))), AND(ISCHANGED(AIConversationMessage__c), NOT(ISBLANK(AIConversationMessage__c))), AND(ISCHANGED(User__c), NOT(ISBLANK(User__c))), AND(ISCHANGED(Detail__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Detail__c)))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A violation is an audit record. Only Review Status can be changed after it is created, apart from removing the person and detail for a data deletion request.
